title: NASA Planned 5 Flights for This Mars Helicopter. It Flew 72

scenes.text: NASA planned five flights. This helicopter flew 72.
Ingenuity landed on Mars in February 2021, built as a one month test.
The plan was five short flights over about 30 days.
Instead it flew 72 times and covered about ten and a half miles.
That's over two hours in the air, as high as 78 feet.
It lasted nearly three years, until a rotor blade was damaged in a January 2024 landing.

description:
NASA planned five flights. This helicopter flew 72.
Ingenuity was meant to be a 30 day test but kept flying for nearly three years, covering about 10.5 miles.
What should NASA fly on Mars next? Comment below.
